old_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a vibrant orange object, which appears to be a piece of fruit or a dessert, coated in a layer of granulated sugar. The surface is glossy, reflecting light, and the sugar crystals are clearly visible, adding texture to the scene. As the camera slowly zooms in, the focus shifts to the center of the orange object, revealing its smooth, juicy interior. The camera then pans slightly downward, showing the orange substance dripping down onto the sugar-coated surface below. The liquid continues to flow, creating a dynamic visual effect as it cascades over the granules. The overall scene captures the contrast between the bright orange hue and the white sugar, emphasizing the texture and movement of the liquid. The video concludes with the orange substance still dripping, leaving a trail of liquid on the sugar-coated surface.

caption: An extreme close-up holds a glossy, translucent orange dome resting on a bed of fine white granules, its wet surface catching a pale crescent highlight near the top and a small bright blob on the right. A fringe of granules already clings to the dome's lower rim. Over the sequence a thin amber liquid seeps out at the base and spreads laterally into the surrounding granules, darkening and wetting that band while the grains farther out stay dry and white. The crisp wavy edge of the dome's bottom softens into a smoother, more diffuse contour as the liquid halo widens. The specular highlights slowly reshape and drift, the right-side blob stretching into a streak and then splitting, consistent with a deforming wet surface. A faint pale squiggle on the left shifts slightly in form. The dome stays centered and broadly constant in size, so the dominant change is the spreading liquid and reshaping reflections rather than any large movement of the body.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
